title: ATME Students selected for Smart India Hackathon 2022
content:
A group of six students from ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru  has  been selected for Smart India Hackathon-2022 Senior Hardware edition Grand Finale. SIH 2022 brings the next generation evolution by inclusion of new methodology to inculcate the culture of start up and innovation ecosystem across different age groups. The Hardware and Software edition of Smart India Hackathon 2022 Senior is scheduled from 24th August to 29th August 2022. The Grand finale will be held at the nodal centre – B. S. Abdur Rahman Crescent Institute of Science & Technology, Chennai, Tamilnadu.

Students of ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru are selected for sixth consecutive year in the Hackathon organized by Ministry of Education in association with other ministries.

The selected students are from the Departments of ECE, CSE and ME. The participants are Mr. Fawaz Ahmed Khan – ECE, Ms. Lavita Joyce - CSE, Mr. Hannan Ahmed Khan – ME, Mr. Chandrakanth J – ME, Mr. Padmanabha K – ME and the team is  lead by Mr. Nagraj S – ECE.  The team mentor is Dr. Bhagyashree S R, Professor and Dean - Research, ATME College of Engineering, and Mysuru.
